scripts.deploy: npm run fonts && npm run art && npm run build && npm run migrate && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy:live: npm run fonts && npm run art && npm run build && npm run migrate:live && wrangler deploy --env live

DB.description: Sealed sessions and QR scans, atomic verification, revocation and alert delivery state. Versioned migrations run before deploy.

VAL.description: Encrypted store and inventory views, and the public Riot client version.

JAR_KEY.description: 32 random bytes, base64. Every session is sealed under a key derived from this one. Rotating it signs everybody out immediately.

RESEND_KEY.description: resend.com API key, for the six-digit code and the morning alert. Leave blank and the app runs without alerts.

RESEND_HOOK.description: The signing secret of a Resend webhook (whsec_…), so a bounce can be believed. Leave blank and the webhook route rejects everything, which is the correct failure.

MAIL_FROM.description: Who the mail comes from. Must be an address on a domain verified in Resend.

EDGE.description: Coarse abuse protection before application work; D1 enforces atomic security limits.
